## Feature Summary
A concise description of the proposed feature, grader, runner, or benchmark domain.

## Motivation & Problem
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? (e.g. "Currently, evaluating multi-turn state transitions in custom sandboxes requires...")

## Proposed Solution / Architecture
Describe your proposed technical solution:
- Affected modules (e.g., `agent_bench.core.protocols`, `agent_bench.graders`, `agent_bench.models`)
- Interface or Protocol changes
- Backward compatibility considerations

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any references to research papers, existing evaluation benchmarks, or documentation.
